query_normalized: the impact of self-talk on resilience to microaggressions psychology
rationale: The paper focuses on computational methods for detecting stress in social media text, which is an off-domain application (NLP/transportation) that does not measure the psychological mechanism of self-talk, the construct of resilience, or the specific impact of microaggressions on human subjects. It fails to satisfy any inclusion criteria as it addresses a distinct construct (automated stress detection) sharing only the general keyword "stress" without connecting to the user's specific variables
